title: IoTKit MQTT Output Adapter v1 Observation payload
description: Payload published to iotkit/v1/edge-node/{edge-node-id}/observation/{pipeline-id}/{kind-key}. The kind is carried by the topic, so validate against $defs/<kind-key>. A zero-length payload on the same topic is a pipeline deletion and is not JSON.

identifier.description: edge-node-id and pipeline-id: lowercase ASCII letters, digits, and hyphens; no leading or trailing hyphen; 1 to 64 bytes.

series_id.description: Opaque string compared only for equality. Consumers must not validate it as a UUID or check a version.

sequence.description: Starts at 1 for every series and increases by 1 per publication. Retransmissions reuse the same value.

uptime_ms.description: Milliseconds since the IoTKit process started, taken from a monotonic clock. Always present. Monotonic within one process run; a decrease means IoTKit restarted. Use it for intervals and gap lengths, not for calendar placement.

unix_epoch_ms.description: Wall-clock time (Unix epoch milliseconds) at which IoTKit received the input that settled this output, or null when IoTKit cannot vouch for its clock (for example before NTP synchronization). The key is always present. Not monotonic; consumers order by sequence.
